concerns.text: The plan falls back to the GHZ placeholder dataset (`https://huggingface.co/datasets/khaoula-ghz/guanaco-llama2-5k/resolve/main/data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet`) when no real paired metabolomics‑herbivory data are found. This placeholder contains no plant metabolite or herbivory measurements, so it cannot address the core research question about metabolite‑herbivore relationships. Consequently, FR‑001 (≥ 50 plant species with paired data) cannot be satisfied, making the dataset choice inappropriate for the intended analysis.
